entities.name: CodY transcriptional regulator
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A6LSN9 from Clostridium beijerinckii; 258 aa, 100% identity and full-length coverage, E-value 1.34e-178.
Annotated as a DNA-binding global transcriptional regulator involved in adaptive responses to starvation and nutrient availability.
Acts mainly as a transcriptional repressor during rapid exponential growth, controlling genes that enable adaptation to nutrient depletion.
Curated localization is cytoplasm; GO annotations include DNA binding, DNA-binding transcription factor activity, GTP binding, and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 28.9 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.67.
Pfam identifies CodY domain PF06018.21 at residues 3-179 and HTH_CodY domain PF08222.18 at residues 199-256.

entities.name: Nutrient starvation adaptation
observations: CodY regulates numerous genes in response to nutrient availability and contributes to bacterial adaptation to starvation or nutrient depletion.

entities.name: CodY GTP binding
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations assign GTP binding to CodY; this ligand-sensing function is associated with nutrient-responsive transcriptional regulation.
